Title: Establishes the "rural water utility modernization and security act"
Summary: Establishes the "rural state water utility modernization and security act" which requires the development and implementation of an action plan for the modernization and enhancement of cybersecurity at all rural water utilities in the state; requires SECURE program funding to prioritize rural water utilities.
LawCode: Add §§1285-v & 1285-w, Pub Auth L; add §89-q, Pub Serv L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the public authorities law and the public service law, in relation to establishing the "rural water utility modernization and security act"
